findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: .NET SDK version is not pinned (no global.json); build tooling floats to whatever SDK is installed
findings.standard: OWASP Software Supply Chain Security Cheat Sheet — OCS-15
findings.recommendation: Add a global.json at the repository root pinning the .NET 10 SDK version (with an explicit rollForward policy such as latestPatch) so builds use a known toolchain.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: No NuGet lock file: RestorePackagesWithLockFile is not enabled and no packages.lock.json exists
findings.standard: OWASP Software Supply Chain Security Cheat Sheet — OCS-12
findings.recommendation: Set <RestorePackagesWithLockFile>true</RestorePackagesWithLockFile> in Directory.Build.props, commit the generated packages.lock.json files, and restore with --locked-mode in CI.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: No SBOM file and no SBOM generator configured in the build
findings.recommendation: Generate a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM as part of the build/release (e.g. Microsoft.Sbom.Targets or the CycloneDX .NET tool) and publish it with the artifacts.
